look.summary_zh: 冷色 · 提亮中灰 · 中段拉开
look.description_zh: 50% 灰输出 Y′ 133.8/255（变化 +6.3 码值）；25%–75% 灰跨度比 1.214。中灰红减蓝 -29.5 码值。浅/中/深肤色色块分别输出 #D0EDD7、#C1A8A7、#6B4F64；红/绿/蓝测试块分别输出 #B03E63、#4BAF72、#0261CF。
look.description_en: 50% gray Y′ 133.8/255 (+6.3 code values); 25–75% gray span ratio 1.214; mid-gray red minus blue -29.5 code values. Light/medium/deep skin swatches: #D0EDD7, #C1A8A7, #6B4F64. Red/green/blue swatches: #B03E63, #4BAF72, #0261CF.
look.suggested_use_zh: 冷色城市、夜景与科技试片
look.suggested_use_en: Compare on your own SDR product, portrait and landscape footage before selecting.
look.cautions_zh: 逐项比较肤色与品牌色，强度过高可能改变产品颜色。仅像素颜色映射，不生成颗粒、光晕、暗角、空间雾或美颜；未做自然画质验收。
look.cautions_en: Pixel color mapping only; no grain, glow, vignette, spatial haze or beauty effects. Natural footage quality is unaccepted. Check skin/product colors and clipped output.
